title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics context enrichment and SLO-toolkit helpers
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: improve the on-call autodiagnostics experience by enriching context passed to runbooks and SLO-toolkit helpers. This change makes it easier for on-call engineers to triage SLO breaches by surfacing correlated alerts, recent deploys, and a compact telemetry digest alongside runbook links.

What this PR does: Adds a context enrichment pipeline that composes a short diagnostic summary (top-5 related alerts, last 3 deploy tags, recent error-rate trend) and exposes it to runbook linking and the SLO-toolkit helpers. Adds a new compact-runbook view and minor polish to the oncall CLI output.

Checklist: 
- [x] Context enrichment pipeline (gatherer + scorer)
- [x] SLO-toolkit helpers integration (slo-hints, compact summaries)
- [x] Unit tests for gatherer and scorer
- [x] e2e test for runbook linking with enriched context
- [x] Updated docs: oncall runbook quicklinks

Notes: The description below is condensed; see changed files for more detail. Linear tickets: ENG-1142 (autodiag UX), ENG-1189 (slo-toolkit helpers). Support ticket SUP-8421 reported a real-world outage where operators lacked correlated alert context. This PR addresses that gap.
